snippet.title: Super Animal World | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The Super Animal World expansion for Super Animal Royale is here! Read the patch notes: https://medium.com/@michael_one/super-animal-world-is-here-a-cozy-new-place-to-kill-your-friends-9ee49af62f13

Explore a new persistent Social Hub, where you can relax, meet NPCs, embark on quests, and enjoy cozy activities like fishing, bug catching, and hamsterball racing... between brutal fights to the death.

Explore, unwind, and matchmake straight from the Social Hub into competitive modes, including Animal Royale, The Bwoking Dead (infection mode), and SAW vs Rebellion (control point mode). After each match, return to the Hub to continue the Circle of Super Life.

We'll have lots more to share soon about Super Animal World on our social media, Discord server and newsletter:
https://twitter.com/animalroyale
https://facebook.com/animalroyale
https://instagram.com/superanimalroyale
https://discord.gg/animalroyale
https://animalroyale.com

Super Animal Royale is a top-down multiplayer survival shooter for up to 64 endearingly deadly creatures. Engineered to charm and trained to kill, Super Animals are cute enough to make you go “Aww” and deadly enough to make you go “Ahhhh!” Select your favorite from a menu of foxes, pandas, kitty cats, and other bloodthirsty beasts, and parachute into the ruins of an ill-fated safari park to fight off a lethal barrage of bullets, explosives, and silly dancing.

Enjoy carefully balanced run and gun gameplay combined with an intuitive fog of war system that restricts a player’s view to line of sight, allowing for sneaky, strategic play. Matches are a brisk 6 minutes, so you’ll never be out of the action for too long. Explore a beautiful 2D world, inspired by classic top-down adventure games. Cut tall grass and loot abandoned structures in search of the guns, bananas and health juice you’ll need to reach the top of the food chain.

Super Animal Royale is lovingly published and developed by Pixile Studios, an indie game studio spread out between North America, Europe and Asia.
